We need to determine appropriate crime(s) based on facts. Facts: On June 25, 2014, Zhang (employee) wanted resignation and wages, boss refused. Zhang bought a lighter, returned to restaurant, cut the LPG cylinder pipe, opened valve to release gas, demanding boss agree to resignation. Boss closed valve, took Zhang to kitchen to negotiate, they didn't reach agreement, Zhang again took lighter and tried to set fire near LPG cylinder, boss stopped and called police. So behavior: dangerous act causing potential explosion, threatening public safety. Likely crime: "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" (dangerous method endangering public safety) or "放火罪" (arson). However, he didn't actually set fire, just threatened to ignite gas. Under Chinese criminal law, "以危险方法危害公共安全罪" includes acts like releasing dangerous gases, threatening explosion, etc. Also "非法点燃燃气" maybe "放火罪" requires actual arson causing fire. Since no fire occurred, it's more likely "以危险方法危害公共安全罪". The key is that he used a lighter near LPG cylinder, which is a dangerous method. So single crime.

Check key rules: Must match official name. The official name is "以危险方法危害公共安全罪". Ensure correct.

Thus final answer: [罪名]以危险方法危害公共安全<eoa>
